description: IV rank and IV percentile per symbol against its rolling history (needs 20+ days). Pass a symbol for its IV-rank time series (lookback_days, limit apply); omit it for a ranked snapshot (e.g. side=put&min_rank=0.8 finds elevated put IV; side=both ranks by the higher of call/put IV rank).

symbol.description: Single ticker for its IV-rank series; omit for the snapshot.
